scope: Oeiras I A5 Lisbon-bound entrance and westbound exit to Oeiras/Paco de Arcos, plus Carcavelos I Lisbon-bound entrance booth/Via Verde lane. Oeiras II and Carcavelos II are excluded. Whole source ways are reviewed and matched independently; old OSM fee tags are not tariff inputs.

identityEvidence.name: Oeiras I
identityEvidence.basis: Brisa distinguishes Oeiras I (Oeiras/Paco de Arcos) from Oeiras II (Porto Salvo/Cacem). Original OSM exit ways 418240487/320186742 carry Oeiras/Paco de Arcos; the opposite adjacent entrance is directed toward Lisboa. Geography is reviewed separately from the current 2026 fare.

identityEvidence.name: Carcavelos I
identityEvidence.basis: The traffic study identifies the Carcavelos I entrance at km 14.5 on the eastbound A5 corridor toward Lisbon/CRIL. Original OSM directed booth and Via Verde ways have Lisboa/Oeiras as destination. Only this entrance is activated; proposed dynamic prices in the paper are not used.
